Mechanic crouches beside an ivory cabover camper's front wheel in a clean garage, checking wheel bolts with a socket wrench. Three-quarter view, face looking at wheel, both hands naturally positioned, entire wheel and work clearly visible. Simple green tool cabinet and garage opening with distant trees.

For the heater consultation, the two people look directly at EACH OTHER or the heater. Keep reference character but do NOT copy reference pose, smile or gaze. This gaze and framing requirement overrides earlier face-presentation directions.
